revenueAndReceivables.basis: CRM rows C-001 to C-004 and WEB-FSB/WEB-NCB support €960,000 August revenue. Cash receipts also include €35,000 opening-AR collection and €90,000 September deposits, which remain contract liabilities.

inventoryAndCOGS.qualification: The physical-count alternative is €121,000. Its €9,000 excess is neither booked as COGS nor used as a balancing entry.

payroll.basis: €15,000 opening payroll payable + €248,000 period payroll expense - €231,000 cash paid = €32,000 closing payroll payable. Aggregate payroll evidence supports these totals; the detailed monthly split is incomplete.

operatingExpenses.insurance: Not recognized: supplied evidence contains no reliable policy, prepaid balance, or consumption amount.

ppeAndDepreciation.basis: The €60,000 machine and €20,000 photo booth are original capital additions; their cash/PPE movements offset, so they do not increase total assets at acquisition.

equityAndDistributions.basis: €125,000 is the residual equity on the primary €112,000 inventory statement basis. €170,000 is an arithmetic roll-forward input (125,000 - 65,000 + 110,000), not a posted opening-equity plug; full opening-balance evidence is missing.

profitAndLoss.basis: Primary evidence-qualified reconstruction using €405,000 COGS and €112,000 flow-derived inventory.

cashFlow.basis: Closing cash agrees to bank evidence.
cashFlow.directMethodBasis: €899,000 receipts less €760,000 identified operating payments = €139,000 net operating cash flow.

balanceSheet.basis: Primary statement basis is €112,000 inventory. €121,000 physical-count inventory is disclosed separately as a €9,000 unresolved alternative, not combined with €65,000 profit.

reconciliations.name: Closing cash to bank and cash flow
reconciliations.calculation: €80,000 opening cash + €139,000 operating - €80,000 investing - €79,000 financing/owner = €60,000, agreeing to the bank export.

reconciliations.name: Revenue and receivables
reconciliations.calculation: €960,000 completed-contract revenue; gross AR €186,000 less R-17 impairment €18,000 = net AR €168,000. €90,000 September receipts remain deposits.

reconciliations.name: PPE and depreciation
reconciliations.calculation: €180,000 opening cost + €60,000 machine + €20,000 photo booth = €260,000; accumulated depreciation €45,000 + €24,000 = €69,000; net PPE €191,000.

reconciliations.name: Debt and interest
reconciliations.calculation: €100,000 opening loan + €50,000 advance - €19,000 principal = €131,000; €12,000 interest expense - €10,000 paid = €2,000 payable.

reconciliations.name: Supplier payable
reconciliations.calculation: Purchases/payments and confirmed AP do not fully reconcile; €45,000 remains for investigation and is not plugged.

reconciliations.name: Equity roll-forward
reconciliations.calculation: Primary closing equity is €125,000 residual: €531,000 assets - €406,000 liabilities. Implied opening equity is €170,000 after €65,000 profit and €110,000 distributions, but the full opening balance sheet is not independently supported.

reconciliations.name: Prepaid insurance
reconciliations.calculation: No reliable insurance policy, prepaid balance, or consumption amount was supplied; no insurance entry has been invented.

reconciliations.name: Unexplained journals
reconciliations.calculation: No €9,000 inventory journal, €45,000 supplier journal, or opening-equity balancing entry has been posted.

uncertainties: €9,000 inventory difference: primary flow €112,000 versus physical-count alternative €121,000; no adjustment posted.
€45,000 supplier/AP reconciliation difference; no balancing journal posted.
Opening balance-sheet evidence is incomplete; the €170,000 equity roll-forward input is arithmetic only, not independently verified.
No reliable insurance/prepaid amount is available; no amount is invented.
Payroll evidence supports aggregate totals; full monthly split support is incomplete.

boardRecommendation.text: Use €65,000 as the primary evidence-qualified reconstruction with €112,000 flow-derived inventory and €125,000 residual equity. Disclose—not book—the €121,000 count-based inventory alternative and the €9,000 difference. Do not use management’s €312,000 claim or any unsupported balancing journal.
